review.footnote: Reviews record progress and XP like practice.

empty.title: All caught up
empty.body: Nothing is due for review right now. New reviews appear here as memories fade.

done.label: Review complete
done.summaryXp: Reviews record progress like practice · +{xp} XP this run.

errors.start: Review failed to start — try again.
errors.ungraded: Grading is temporarily unavailable — please try again.

pace.title: 25–45 questions · about 30–45 minutes
pace.detail: The test adapts to you. Clear answers mean fewer questions.

honest.title: Answer from what you know — no searching
honest.detail: Honest answers put you at the right starting point. Looked-up answers put you in the wrong place.

speed.title: Speed counts
speed.detail: Fast correct answers show mastery and shorten the test.

pause.title: Pause anytime
pause.detail: Leave and pick up where you stopped.

format.title: Up to 5 questions · timed · closed book
format.detail: Each question has its own timer. Keep books and notes shut.

scope.title: Covers what you just learned
scope.detail: Questions come from your recent lessons.

miss.title: A wrong answer shows you why
miss.detail: The worked solution appears straight away, and anything worth revisiting is listed when the quiz ends.

xp.title: XP for each correct answer · retake anytime
xp.detail: Faster answers and longer streaks earn more. No penalty for retaking.

due.title: Only what is due for review
due.detail: Questions come from concepts whose memory is fading.

honest.title: Answer from what you remember — no searching
honest.detail: Honest answers recalibrate your next review date.

speed.title: Speed counts
speed.detail: Fast correct answers show the memory is solid.

xp.title: XP for each correct answer
xp.detail: Reviews record progress and XP like practice.

allLearned.title: Concept graph
allLearned.detail: Nothing is due right now — the graph shows what builds on what you have

prereq.heading: Prerequisites ({count})
prereq.defaultIntro: You're not ready to practise this topic yet. Study the prerequisites below, then return to check your readiness.

prereqDialog.title: Prerequisite path
prereqDialog.description: You're not ready to practise this topic yet. Study the prerequisites below, then return to check readiness.
prereqDialog.heading: Prerequisites

submitError.sessionGone: Session expired — the server restarted and forgot this run.
submitError.throttled: Saving is catching up — your answer is kept and will be sent again.
submitError.failed: Couldn't submit your answer — it's still in the box.
submitError.noSkips: No skips left — restart for a fresh run.

study.statusFailed: Couldn't refresh this concept's status. You can still read the material below.

ready.title: Ready to practise?
ready.body: Work toward mastery in the assessed learning flow. Reading here does not count as progress.

reference.loadFailed: Couldn't load the reference for {label}. The questions below still work.
reference.unavailable: Detailed study material is not available for this concept yet. You can still explore its prerequisites and related concepts, return to your original topic, or check whether practice is available.
reference.note: Reference explains. It does not count as progress — only the questions below move this concept.

report.label: Report a problem
report.title: Complain about this question or explanation

tooltip.arithmetic: Numbers, the four operations, fractions and powers
tooltip.algebra: Letters, numbers, the four operations, structures
tooltip.calculus: Limits, derivatives, integrals, the four operations

assistant.limit: That is today’s limit for the assistant. The rest of Mathua works as usual.
assistant.unavailable: The assistant is unavailable right now. Everything else still works.
assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.offline: The assistant is unavailable right now. These go to the same places:

consent.title: Before you send a message
consent.body: Your text goes to an AI provider so it can answer. Do not type names, email addresses, school details, or anything about another person.
consent.notSent: Your answers, progress and account details are not sent. The message is not stored after it is answered. Replies can be wrong.
consent.checkbox: I am 13 or older, and I understand this.

assistant.intro: Ask what Mathua is, or where to begin. Answers are short, and you can follow the links.

prereqIntro.dueCheck: You have already learned {names} — a short check is due, or continue anyway.
prereqIntro.allLearned: You have already learned what this builds on. You can revisit it any time.
prereqIntro.unmet: This builds on {names}. A quick study helps — or continue anyway.

stepper.bandTitle: How you're doing on this concept, from your recent answers. Progress only — mastery is decided separately.
stepper.workedExampleMissing: Worked example unavailable — start practicing instead.
stepper.halt: Stepping down a level — easier question below.

errors.exhaustedEnd: This topic ran out of new questions, so the section ended here.
errors.exhaustedNothingLeft: This topic ran out of new questions, so there was nothing left to work through.
errors.noQuestion: Could not load a question — check your connection and reload.
errors.expiredFresh: That question had expired on the server, so it could not be graded. Here is a fresh one — nothing was recorded.
errors.expiredNoReplacement: That question had expired and no replacement could be loaded. Reload to continue.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach the server to grade that answer. Check your connection and submit again — nothing was recorded.

done.scrollUp: Scroll up to review anything. Reviews are scheduled automatically.
done.comingUp: Coming up — unlocks once this concept is mastered
